name: essay-writer-editor
description: Plan, draft, research, edit, review, and analyse essays while preserving evidence and voice.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, draft, edit, and review stronger essays
interface.longDescription: Write an essay from a topic, brief, notes, rubric, or supplied sources; revise an existing draft; research competing evidence; or review probable AI-writing signals with clear uncertainty.
defaultPrompt: Draft an essay from my notes without inventing evidence.
Revise my essay while preserving my argument and voice.
Assess this text for probable AI-writing signals and explain the uncertainty.
